ObjectRotateGallery.apply_flip_horizontal: Flip the teardrop shape horizontally (left to right).
ObjectRotateGallery.apply_flip_vertical: Flip the teardrop shape vertically (top to bottom).

PicturePositionGallery.apply_bottom_right: Position the teardrop shape at the bottom-right corner of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).
PicturePositionGallery.apply_middle_center: Position the teardrop shape at the middle-center of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).
PicturePositionGallery.apply_top_center: Position the teardrop shape at the top-center of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).
PicturePositionGallery.apply_top_left: Position the teardrop shape at the top-left corner of the page, using the Position preset (within default page margins).

TextWrapGallery.apply_behind: Apply behind text wrapping to the cross shape (text appears on top of the cross).
TextWrapGallery.apply_square: Apply square wrapping to the cross shape (text wraps around the cross's rectangular bounding box).
TextWrapGallery.apply_tight: Apply tight wrapping to the cross shape (text follows closely along the cross's edges).
TextWrapGallery.apply_top_bottom: Apply top and bottom wrapping to the cross shape (text appears above and below the cross only).
